resolutions.researcher_notes: Identity check first: GEM's own Length/Diameter refs on this row (both = the almalnews.com seed citation) already peg P7572 at LengthKnown=206km, Diameter=10in, and OtherLanguagePrimaryPipelineName = 'انبوب غاز حقل كروان' (= 'Karawan field gas pipeline'). Confirmed against the almalnews.com/9021 article (verified OK, published 2012-11-10): it describes the Karawan-field pipeline within Petrobel's Denis+Karawan (DEKA) development in the offshore Temsah Concession as exactly '206 km, 10-inch pipeline tying into the existing 32-inch line' feeding the El Gamil onshore plant. So P7572 'Qarun Gas Pipeline' is NOT the Western Desert Qarun oil/gas field (Apache/Qarun Petroleum Co) -- it is the Karawan segment of the DEKA project; 'Qarun' appears to be a GEM naming artifact. Status: the current ref (petro-news.com/95212/) is live (200, verified separately) but is a generic Oct-2024 roundup of '39 Egyptian gas projects' -- it lists 'Denise and Karawan fields development' as a capacity-expansion item without stating operating status, so it does not specifically support 'operating' for this pipeline; replaced rather than reused. offshore-mag.com/subsea/.../deka-project-begins-production-offshore-egypt (Offshore magazine, Endeavor Business Media) and egyptoil-gas.com/features/deka-development-project-2/ (Egypt Oil & Gas, Egyptian trade press) are independent origins that both confirm the DEKA (Denis-Karawan) project -- the project that installed this Karawan pipeline -- reached first gas in August 2014 via the Petrobel-operated Temsah Concession infrastructure feeding El Gamil; a third source (offshore-technology.com, verified to contain 'Karawan') corroborates onstream status but was not needed given the two above already meet the 2-independent bar. No source found indicating shut-in/decommission since 2014, consistent with 'operating'. Contradiction flag: none on Status itself, but flag for a human pass that PipelineName 'Qarun Gas Pipeline' may be a misnomer for what every underlying source calls the Karawan (or Denis-Karawan/DEKA) pipeline -- worth a naming/OtherEnglishNames review, out of scope for this ref-only pass.

Same identity basis as the Status unit: this row is the Karawan-field pipeline of Petrobel's Denis+Karawan (DEKA) development in the Temsah Concession. egyptoil-gas.com/features/deka-development-project-2/ states 'The DEKA project launched by Petrobel is targeting the development of both the Denise and Karawan fields...'; offshore-mag.com/subsea/.../deka-project-begins-production-offshore-egypt states the project is operated via 'Petrobel (50% IEOC and 50% EGPC)' in the Temsah Concession. These are two independent origins (Egypt Oil & Gas vs. Offshore magazine) both naming Petrobel as operator. Petrobel = Belayim Petroleum Co (the GEM value, incl. its Arabic form شركة بترول بلاعيم) -- confirmed by a third, independent egyptoil-gas.com article (Petrobel Sets New Production Record, 2019-08-27, verified OK) which spells out the full legal name verbatim: 'Belayim Petroleum Company (Petrobel)'. Also consistent with the almalnews.com/9021 seed citation (2012, already an existing ref on this row for Length/Diameter), which independently states 'بترول بلاعيم' (Belayim Petroleum) is the company executing the Denis/Karawan development. No contradiction found; Owner field on this row (General Petroleum Co) is a separate GEM column (asset owner, not operator) and is not in scope for this unit.
